PC: I&D is first line treatment for simple abscess.
Antibiotic therapy is reserved for severe, extensive or rapidly progressing abscess with or without cellulitis.
In non-purulent cellulitis or indeterminate SSTI, ultrasound if available may be done to exclude drainable abscess.
Decolonization to be considered if recurrent SSTI with patient or in household members despite optimal wound therapy, appropriate personal, and environmental hygiene.
Oral antimicrobials are for active infections and not for decolonization.
MK: That with the family history of likely CA-MRSA that recurrence is possible
ICS: That eradication of the organism is difficult but that some strategies with body hygiene and decontamination may be helpful.
